participant_1.name: Emily
participant_1.personality: Practical and down-to-earth, Emily enjoys the simple pleasures of life and values her time spent in nature.
participant_1.background: My husband is adopted. I live in a rural farming community. I have a German shepherd dog. I like to watch NHL hockey.

participant_2.name: Jordan
participant_2.personality: Creative and a bit anxious, Jordan expresses a love for gardening and hockey while grappling with past trauma.
participant_2.background: I'm terrified of clowns due to childhood trauma. I was adopted at a young age to an older couple. I enjoy working with my hands and love gardening. I just got a job working in a gas station. My father keeps trying to set me up on blind dates.
